page.title: notの位置で、意味の範囲が変わる

analysis.summaryJa: notは単に文全体を否定するだけでなく、直後に置かれた語句・不定詞・目的・様態へ打消しの範囲を向ける。画像の移動するNOTライトを根拠に、didn’t try to doとtried not to do、didn’t deliberately doとdeliberately didn’t doなど、位置で変わる意図を区別する。
grammarPoints: did not＋動詞は主節の行為を否定する
動詞＋not to doはto不定詞の行為を否定する
not＋語句で否定対象を限定する
否定文では通常any系列を用い、not ... anyの語順にする
notとdeliberately・becauseなどの位置で否定範囲が変わる
visualEvidence: 画像上部の文レールでNOTライトの右側だけが暗くなっている
didn’t try to crossとtried not to crossの対比カードが試行自体と行為の否定を分ける
not me・not at night・not to wake anyoneという範囲バッジがある
not ... anyの順序を示す注意カードがある
commonTraps: didn’t try to doを「しないよう努力した」と解釈する
not to doとto not doの位置を無自覚に混同する
否定文でsomeを使い、anyとの基本対応を崩す
副詞の前後にあるnotが同じ意味だと考える

questions.prompt: The analyst tried ------- to reveal any client names in the presentation.

choices.A: don't
choices.B: no
choices.C: not

questions.translationJa: 分析担当者はプレゼンで顧客名を一切明かさないよう努めました。
questions.explanationJa: tried not to revealは「明かさないよう努力した」で、notがto revealを否定します。

questions.prompt: We lowered our voices ------- to disturb the interview in the next room.

choices.A: not
choices.B: no
choices.C: didn't

questions.translationJa: 隣室の面接を邪魔しないよう、私たちは声を落としました。
questions.explanationJa: 目的を表すto不定詞の直前にnotを置き、not to disturbとします。

questions.prompt: The delay was caused by a software error, ------- by staff negligence.

choices.A: no
choices.B: didn't
choices.C: wasn't

questions.translationJa: 遅延の原因はソフトウェアのエラーであり、職員の怠慢ではありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: not by staff negligenceが原因を示す前置詞句だけを否定します。

questions.prompt: The company did not receive ------- applications after the deadline.

choices.A: some
choices.B: any
choices.C: no

questions.translationJa: 会社は締切後、応募を一件も受け取りませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 否定文did not receiveでは通常anyを用いて「一つもない」と表します。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ortega ------- deliberately omit the shipping fee; it was a formula error.

choices.A: didn't
choices.B: not
choices.C: wasn't

questions.translationJa: オルテガさんが配送料を意図的に省いたのではなく、数式の誤りでした。
questions.explanationJa: didn’t deliberately omitは「意図的に省いた」というまとまりを否定します。

questions.prompt: The supervisor deliberately ------- approve the incomplete form.

choices.A: not
choices.B: wasn't
choices.C: didn't

questions.translationJa: 上司は意図的に、その未完成の書類を承認しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: deliberately didn’t approveは「意図的に承認しなかった」という否定行為を表します。

questions.prompt: The training is for new hires, ------- for temporary visitors.

choices.A: no
choices.B: not
choices.C: doesn't

questions.translationJa: その研修は新入社員向けで、臨時の来訪者向けではありません。
questions.explanationJa: not for temporary visitorsが対象を示す句だけを否定します。

questions.prompt: The team agreed ------- to release the figures before the audit ended.

choices.A: didn't
choices.B: no
choices.C: wasn't

questions.translationJa: チームは監査が終わる前には数値を公表しないことで合意しました。
questions.explanationJa: agreed not to releaseは、公表しないことに合意したという意味です。

questions.prompt: The courier did not attempt ------- the damaged package.

choices.A: to open
choices.B: not opening
choices.C: opened

questions.translationJa: 配達員は破損した荷物を開けようとはしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not attemptが試み自体を否定し、attemptの後ろにはto openを置きます。

questions.prompt: The revised schedule applies to weekdays, ------- to public holidays.

choices.A: no
choices.B: not
choices.C: doesn't

questions.translationJa: 改訂日程は平日には適用されますが、祝日には適用されません。
questions.explanationJa: not to public holidaysがappliesの対象だけを対比的に否定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence meaning that the team made an effort to avoid a late departure.

choices.A: The team did not try to leave late.
choices.B: The team tried to not left late.
choices.C: The team did not tried leaving late.
choices.D: The team tried not to leave late.

questions.translationJa: チームは遅く出発しないよう努めました。
questions.explanationJa: try not to leaveはleaveという行為を否定し、試みた事実は肯定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about protecting confidential data.

choices.A: Please not close the screen to expose customer data.
choices.B: Please close the screen not to expose customer data.
choices.C: Please close not the screen to expose customer data.
choices.D: Please close the screen to not exposed customer data.

questions.translationJa: 顧客データを見せないために画面を閉じてください。
questions.explanationJa: 否定目的はnot to exposeで表し、notはto不定詞の直前に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence emphasizing that the location, not the date, changed.

choices.A: The venue not changed, the date.
choices.B: Not the venue changed the date.
choices.C: The venue changed, not the date.
choices.D: The venue changed no the date.

questions.translationJa: 変更されたのは会場であり、日付ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: not the dateが対比対象だけを否定し、前のchangedを補って理解できます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about having zero available rooms.

choices.A: The hotel does not have any rooms available tonight.
choices.B: The hotel does not have some rooms available tonight.
choices.C: The hotel has not any rooms available tonight.
choices.D: The hotel does not has any rooms available tonight.

questions.translationJa: そのホテルには今夜利用できる部屋が一室もありません。
questions.explanationJa: 一般動詞否定does not haveとanyの組合せが正しい語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence meaning that the clerk’s failure to call was intentional.

choices.A: The clerk did not deliberately call the supplier.
choices.B: The clerk deliberately not called the supplier.
choices.C: The clerk did deliberately not called the supplier.
choices.D: The clerk deliberately did not call the supplier.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は意図的に仕入先へ電話しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: deliberatelyがdid not call全体を修飾し、電話しなかったことが意図的だと示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence meaning that the assistant did not intentionally delete the file.

choices.A: The assistant deliberately did not delete the file.
choices.B: The assistant did not delete deliberately the file no.
choices.C: The assistant did not deliberately delete the file.
choices.D: The assistant was not deliberately delete the file.

questions.translationJa: アシスタントが意図的にファイルを削除したわけではありません。
questions.explanationJa: did not deliberately deleteは「意図的に削除した」を否定し、事故の可能性を残します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a purpose.

choices.A: The driver slowed down so as to not damaged the equipment.
choices.B: The driver slowed down so as not to damage the equipment.
choices.C: The driver did not slowed down to damage the equipment.
choices.D: The driver slowed not down so as damage the equipment.

questions.translationJa: 運転手は機器を傷めないよう速度を落としました。
questions.explanationJa: so as not to damageは否定の目的を表す正しいまとまりです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence limiting a rule by time.

choices.A: The cafeteria not is open on weekdays on weekends.
choices.B: The cafeteria is no open on weekdays, not weekends.
choices.C: The cafeteria is open not weekdays, on weekends.
choices.D: The cafeteria is open on weekdays, not on weekends.

questions.translationJa: 食堂は平日は営業していますが、週末は営業していません。
questions.explanationJa: not on weekendsが営業時期だけを対比的に否定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence meaning that no attempt to negotiate was made.

choices.A: The vendor tried not to negotiate the price.
choices.B: The vendor did not tried to negotiate the price.
choices.C: The vendor did not try to negotiate the price.
choices.D: The vendor tried to not negotiated the price.

questions.translationJa: 業者は価格交渉を試みませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not try to negotiateはtry自体を否定し、交渉を避ける努力とは異なります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the source of a complaint.

choices.A: The complaint came from a tenant, not from the building owner.
choices.B: The complaint did not came from a tenant but owner.
choices.C: The complaint came not a tenant from the owner.
choices.D: The complaint no came from a tenant, not the owner.

questions.translationJa: 苦情は建物所有者ではなく、入居者から寄せられました。
questions.explanationJa: not from the building ownerがfrom句を対比し、否定範囲を明確にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We tried not to postpone the launch."

choices.A: We made an effort to keep the original launch date.
choices.B: We made no attempt to postpone the launch.
choices.C: We postponed the launch without trying.
choices.D: We tried to arrange a later launch date.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは当初の発売日を維持しようと努めました。
questions.explanationJa: tried not to postponeは延期しないよう努力したことを表します。
questions.focus: try not to doの言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We did not try to postpone the launch."

choices.A: We tried hard to avoid a postponement.
choices.B: We successfully advanced the launch date.
choices.C: We postponed the launch after several attempts.
choices.D: We made no attempt to move the launch to a later date.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは発売を延期しようとはしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not tryは延期を試みたという行為自体を否定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The gift is for Ms. Kato, not for her assistant."

choices.A: Both Ms. Kato and her assistant should receive gifts.
choices.B: Only the assistant should receive the gift.
choices.C: Ms. Kato, rather than her assistant, should receive the gift.
choices.D: Ms. Kato selected a gift for her assistant.

questions.translationJa: その贈り物を受け取るのは、アシスタントではなく加藤さんです。
questions.explanationJa: not for her assistantが受取人だけを否定し、for Ms. Katoと対比します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The report did not contain any pricing errors."

choices.A: Some pricing errors remained in the report.
choices.B: There were no pricing errors in the report.
choices.C: The report contained errors but no prices.
choices.D: The prices were removed from the report.

questions.translationJa: その報告書には価格の誤りが一つもありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: not contain anyはcontain noと同じくゼロを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The technician did not intentionally disconnect the server."

choices.A: The disconnection may have been accidental.
choices.B: The technician intentionally kept the server disconnected.
choices.C: The technician chose not to reconnect the server.
choices.D: The server was never connected by a technician.

questions.translationJa: 切断は偶発的だった可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: did not intentionally disconnectは意図性を否定し、切断自体までは否定していません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The technician intentionally did not disconnect the server."

choices.A: The technician accidentally disconnected the server.
choices.B: The technician forgot whether the server was connected.
choices.C: The technician deliberately left the server connected.

questions.translationJa: 技術者は意図的にサーバーを接続したままにしました。
questions.explanationJa: intentionally did not disconnectは、切断しない選択が意図的だったことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We used a private channel not to interrupt the meeting."

choices.A: We interrupted the meeting to discuss the private channel.
choices.B: The meeting ended because the channel was unavailable.
choices.C: We did not use any channel during the meeting.
choices.D: We used a private channel so that the meeting could continue undisturbed.

questions.translationJa: 会議を妨げないよう、私たちは非公開チャンネルを使いました。
questions.explanationJa: not to interruptは非公開チャンネルを使った目的を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The discount applies online, not at retail stores."

choices.A: Customers can receive the discount online only.
choices.B: Retail stores offer a larger version of the discount.
choices.C: The discount applies both online and in stores.
choices.D: Online customers cannot receive the discount.

questions.translationJa: 顧客がその割引を受けられるのはオンラインだけです。
questions.explanationJa: not at retail storesが適用場所を否定し、onlineに限定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The manager did not specifically request a printed copy."

choices.A: The manager explicitly refused every printed copy.
choices.B: A printed copy may be acceptable, but it was not explicitly requested.
choices.C: The manager requested that nothing be printed.
choices.D: Only a printed copy will satisfy the manager.

questions.translationJa: 印刷版でもよいかもしれませんが、明確に求められたわけではありません。
questions.explanationJa: not specifically requestは「特に指定して求めた」ことだけを否定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The invoice was sent on Tuesday, not on Monday."

choices.A: The invoice was sent on both Monday and Tuesday.
choices.B: The invoice had not been sent by Tuesday.
choices.C: Tuesday was the sending day rather than Monday.
choices.D: Monday’s invoice was canceled on Tuesday.

questions.translationJa: 請求書の送付日は月曜日ではなく火曜日でした。
questions.explanationJa: not on Mondayが時点だけを否定し、on Tuesdayと対比します。

questions.prompt: The speakers had already entered the room. We closed the door quietly ------- to distract them.

choices.A: no
choices.B: not
choices.C: didn't

questions.translationJa: 講演者はすでに部屋に入っていました。気を散らさないよう、私たちは静かに扉を閉めました。
questions.explanationJa: 行動の目的を否定するためnot to distractとします。

questions.prompt: Ms. Young wanted the contract to remain confidential. She asked us ------- to forward it outside the legal team.

choices.A: didn't
choices.B: no
choices.C: weren't

questions.translationJa: ヤングさんは契約書を機密のままにしたいと考え、法務チーム外へ転送しないよう私たちに求めました。
questions.explanationJa: ask＋人＋not to doで「人に～しないよう頼む」を表します。

questions.prompt: The complaint concerns the installation service. It is ------- about the product itself.

choices.A: not
choices.B: no
choices.C: doesn't

questions.translationJa: その苦情は設置サービスに関するもので、製品自体についてではありません。
questions.explanationJa: not about the productが苦情の対象範囲だけを否定します。

questions.prompt: The candidate submitted a résumé but ------- include any references.

choices.A: wasn't
choices.B: doesn't included
choices.C: didn't

questions.translationJa: 応募者は履歴書を提出しましたが、推薦者情報を一件も記載しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の一般動詞includeの否定はdidn’t includeで、anyと組み合わせます。

questions.prompt: The courier ------- knowingly leave the parcel at the wrong address. The label was unreadable.

choices.A: doesn't
choices.B: wasn't
choices.C: not

questions.translationJa: 配達員が承知の上で荷物を誤った住所に置いたわけではありません。ラベルが読めなかったのです。
questions.explanationJa: didn’t knowingly leaveは「承知の上で置いた」という意図性を否定します。

questions.prompt: The supervisor knew the form was incomplete. She knowingly ------- sign it.

choices.A: wasn't
choices.B: didn't
choices.C: not

questions.translationJa: 上司は書類が未完成だと知っていて、意図的に署名しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: knowingly didn’t signは署名しなかった判断が意図的だったことを表します。

questions.prompt: The notice is intended for contractors. It is ------- for permanent employees.

choices.A: not
choices.B: no
choices.C: doesn't

questions.translationJa: その通知は請負業者向けで、正社員向けではありません。
questions.explanationJa: not for permanent employeesが対象を限定して否定します。

questions.prompt: The machine is noisy, so please use the side entrance ------- to disturb customers in the lobby.

choices.A: no
choices.B: don't
choices.C: never

questions.translationJa: 機械の音が大きいので、ロビーの顧客を邪魔しないよう脇の入口を使ってください。
questions.explanationJa: useの目的を表すto不定詞をnotで否定し、not to disturbとします。

questions.prompt: The buyer asked about delivery speed. She did ------- ask whether gift wrapping was available.

choices.A: no
choices.B: didn't
choices.C: not

questions.translationJa: 購入者が尋ねたのは配送速度で、ギフト包装の有無は尋ねませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not askが後続のwhether節を含む質問行為を否定します。

questions.prompt: The update changes the mobile app, ------- the desktop version.

choices.A: no
choices.B: not
choices.C: doesn't

questions.translationJa: その更新で変更されるのはモバイルアプリであり、デスクトップ版ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: not the desktop versionが変更対象を明確に限定します。
